## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Mexico City, Mexico. It starts at Autopista Ecatepec Pirámides Km. 22 600.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Get return transport to the Mexican archaeological complex of Teotihuacán from Mexico City. Skip the lines with fast-track entrance and explore the Pyramids of the Sun and Moon, see the Butterflies Temple, the Avenue of the Dead, the Temple of Quetzalcoatl, and the onsite museum.
>
> Enjoy some free time to have lunch (not included) and later, return to Mexico City.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €77.01. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 98 ratings and 93 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
